experiment_id.principle: Identifies the exact Exp5312 artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse this verifier with prior adaptive-memory experiments.

field_principles.continuous_self_learning: Bare milestone gate showing this is a continuous self-learning memory-safety experiment, not a static documentation update.
field_principles.coverage_score: Bare numeric gate over committed safe transitions; missing required evidence-backed facts lowers the score.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identifies the exact Exp5312 artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse this verifier with prior adaptive-memory experiments.
field_principles.faithfulness_score: Bare numeric gate over committed safe transitions; unsupported or stale writes lower the score.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal Exp5312 verdict; starts with complete: or blocked_ and states whether unsafe memory writes were rejected before commit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic fixture scoring with no live LLM, API judge, model generation, fine-tuning, adapter update, or weight mutation.
field_principles.memory_transition_verifier_ready: Bare downstream gate for Exp5313; true only when safe transitions commit, unsafe transitions are rejected, tests pass, and no model weights mutate.
field_principles.milestone: Binds the result to milestone v485 so the conductor can require one continuous self-learning experiment for the milestone.
field_principles.preservation_score: Bare numeric gate over committed safe transitions; unrelated memory corruption lowers the score.
field_principles.status: Reports whether the verifier is usable by Exp5313 instead of merely present as code.
field_principles.tests_run: Records the exact verification commands used to establish that the verifier and artifact are usable by Exp5313.
field_principles.transition_label_counts: Counts every required transition label so unsafe rejection cannot hide missing omission, corruption, hallucination, stale, conflict, forgetting, or rollback cases.
field_principles.unsafe_transition_rejection_rate: Bare numeric gate requiring unsafe omission, corruption, hallucination, and stale-retention writes to be rejected.
field_principles.verifier_path: Points to the deterministic verifier helper used by tests and the artifact so downstream code can import the same implementation.
